description: Move the subscription down one tier (or to an explicit lower `tier`) now: the lower limits and credits apply right away, the lower price starts at the next renewal, and the rest of the current period is not refunded. Strictly downward only. Requires billing:write. Only call after the user explicitly confirms.

confirm.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirms the downgrade.

tier.description: Optional explicit target tier. Omit to drop one tier automatically.

name: downgrade_subscription
